shared_context.topic: corneal abrasion symptoms and eye discharge

atoms.1: Corneal abrasions typically cause symptoms such as pain.
atoms.2: Corneal abrasions typically cause symptoms such as tearing.
atoms.3: Corneal abrasions typically cause symptoms such as photophobia.
atoms.4: Corneal abrasions typically cause symptoms such as foreign body sensation.
atoms.5: Corneal abrasions typically cause symptoms such as a gritty feeling.
atoms.6: Corneal abrasions do not usually result in discharge from the eye.
atoms.7: The primary symptoms of corneal abrasions are related to the disruption of the corneal epithelium.
atoms.8: Disruption of the corneal epithelium leads to a reflex production of tears.
atoms.9: Disruption of the corneal epithelium does not usually lead to discharge.
atoms.10: Discharge from the eye could indicate a secondary infection.
atoms.11: Discharge from the eye could indicate a different underlying condition.
atoms.12: Discharge from the eye should be evaluated further.
